name: cellar
description: Cellar - a self-hosted, single-tenant YouTube archiver.
author: Max Hogan
//typescript: Pinned to 6.x, not 7.x: typescript-eslint 8.71 declares peer typescript '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0'. Revisit when typescript-eslint supports TS 7.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run lint:ascii && npm run lint:private
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w e2e
